messages:
mia: running into redwoodctl login failing in our CI image. installer didn't detect the config dir when dotfiles are symlinked from the workspace.

mia: repro steps i used in the alpine-based job: 
```
mkdir -p /home/runner/.config
ln -s /workspace/dotfiles/redwood /home/runner/.config/redwood
redwoodctl login --non-interactive
```

mia: error printed: "failed to find config dir: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/redwood not found"

samir: hmm, CI images often have XDG_CONFIG_HOME unset or HOME=/root. we should fallback to $HOME/.config and follow symlinks.

jen: which redwoodctl version are you on? installer vs tarball differences matter.

mia: 0.14.3 from apt in the image, also confirmed with the tarball we ship to mirror (same behavior).

samir: quick workaround: export XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/workspace/dotfiles or set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG=/workspace/dotfiles/redwood before login.

mia: that workaround works for the job. but the installer treats the symlink as "missing" because it uses Lstat check that rejects symlinks to directories inside the workspace.

jen: can you paste ls -la output for the config dir? helps debug permission vs symlink handling.

mia: ```
$ ls -la /home/runner/.config
total 8
drwxr-xr-x    2 runner   runner    4096 Mar  1 12:00 .
drwxr-xr-x   22 runner   runner    4096 Mar  1 11:59 ..
lrwxrwxrwx    1 runner   runner      28 Mar  1 11:59 redwood -> /workspace/dotfiles/redwood
```

samir: yep looks like follow-symlink behavior. installer should switch to os.Stat (follow) instead of os.Lstat (no follow) and also check for read permissions. i'll open a tiny PR.

mia: also saw login hang in a separate job when /etc/passwd had no entry for the CI runtime user (HOME empty). login spinner just kept going until timeout. maybe default HOME fallback is needed.

jen: filing a QA ticket to add a smoke test for our common CI base images (alpine, debian-slim, gh-runner) so we catch regressions.

devops-bot: CI artifact uploaded for reproducer: https://ci.internal/1287/artifacts (job 1287)

samir: i will target a fix for the rc/0.15.0 patch and add CI repro to the devex smoke-run. also add docs note about REDWOODCTL_CONFIG / XDG_CONFIG_HOME for CI.

mia: awesome — thanks. :thumbsup: 

jen: can you drop the minimal reproducer script in the ticket so QA can flip the flag?

mia: will do in the next comment in the issue with the job link and Dockerfile snippet.
